text:
Riley: Morning triage — volume spiked ~2.5x overnight, seeing a cluster of webhook failures tied to Stripe retries. Current snapshot: 98 open tickets, 12 high, 4 billing-related. Anyone taking point? :eyes:

Samir: I'll take it. Can you paste an example error or a recent ticket ID?

Riley: Pasting a sanitized log from one of the failing handlers:
```
2026-03-17T02:14:12Z ERROR webhook.worker: validation failed id=evt_1Jx... reason=signature_mismatch header=stripe-signature
stack=ValueError: signature mismatch
```
Ticket example: #SUP-3248 (billing webhook failure).

triage-bot: Created incident INC-2026 and assigned to Samir. Notifying on-call.

Olivia: Quick FYI — we've seen signature_mismatch when customers re-send older events with deprecated signing keys. There is an existing KB macro and a slightly updated macro we want to use: `billing-webhook-retry-v3`. It explains retry etiquette + next steps for customers. Link to macro: https://kb.redwood.ai/macros/billing-webhook-retry-v3

Priya: If this is key-rotation noise, we can avoid escalations. Samir, if you need an ENG rollback or a short-circuit flag to accept legacy sigs, ping me and I can fast-track.

Samir: Investigating — initial findings: about 72% of failed events have `Stripe-Signature` header version `v0` (legacy). Our validation recently tightened to require `v1`. Short-term plan: allow legacy sigs for 1 hour while we surface POST attempts and notify affected customers. Longer: update the webhook docs and add metric for legacy-sig rate.

Samir: Hotfix plan:
```
# config change (staging only)
WEBHOOK_SIG_LEGACY_ACCEPT=true
# rollout plan: staging smoke -> canary 10% -> 50% -> 100% (30m buckets)
```
I'll open the PR and post link here in 10m.

Riley: Thanks. Queue & macros update: I've applied `billing-webhook-retry-v3` to the ten active billing tickets. Please use that macro going forward — it includes the exact troubleshooting steps and the escalation checkbox so we don't miss followups.

Jen: Small request — I updated the macro text to be clearer about the retry window and added the `@escalate` checkbox. PR: https://github.com/redwood-support/macros/pull/88 can someone glance? @Olivia @Priya :wave:

Olivia: I'll review in the next 15. If it's small we can merge and deploy macros immediately. :thumbsup:

Priya: On call if Samir needs a fast rollback or to toggle rate limits. Also note: tickets SUP-3251 and SUP-3254 are blocked waiting on logs from the Payments infra team. Samir, can you request the additional traces?

Samir: Yep, requesting traces now (pinging @payments-infra). Also opening a small smoke test harness to replay a few sample events with legacy signatures. Will update in this thread once staging smoke passes.

Riley: Current triage counts after assignments: 86 open, 9 high, 2 blocked on ENG, 6 awaiting customer response. Will do a follow-up in 30m with final handoff for the shift.

triage-bot: Reminder — daily triage checklist due in 25m. Use macro `shift-handoff` to note any outstanding blockers.

Samir: Staging smoke green. PR here: https://github.com/redwood-internal/webhooks/pull/412 — rolling canary now (10%).

Jen: Quick note — if any customer replies use macro `billing-webhook-retry-v3` and tick the `escalate` checkbox if they mention revenue impact.

Riley: Great work team. I'll prepare the handoff summary with ticket IDs and macro usages. Back in 30. :coffee:
